messages.text:
I’ve got enough of the live formatting now: plain default is one entry per line in non-TTY, `--grid` is columnar, long mode uses compact Windows-style mode/size/date/name, and missing paths exit 2.

Next I’m writing a small Python port with deliberately scoped option parsing rather than trying to recreate the whole Rust CLI machinery.
